content: {"episode_id":"ep-05024","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229); the case records show that prior authorization is missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia (I48.0,I47.1). Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to accurately characterize the frequency and duration of these arrhythmic events for optimal management."}
